decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted and Planning Design and Access Statement, Corporate Events - Noise Assessment (10074/DR 14 May 2010), Lighting Impact Report (2330 2 June 2010), Transport Statement (2416/01 TS01a Version 01 June 2010), Events Travel Plan (June 2010), Car Park Management Plan for Events (2416/03 June 2010 CPMP Events 1b, Version 1), Figure A-1, A-2, 1.1, 1.2 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the use is undertaken.

Condition : 3 - Internal noise levels shall be limited to Laeq 90dB and maximum noise levels should be limited such that LAFMAX 95dB is not exceeded. PA equipment used in the open plan event spaces within the building shall be set up during installation and tested to ensure compliance with these levels. Noise from the premises shall be inaudible at the nearest residential receptor.

Condition : 4 - The proposed security gates to the east and west of the building shall be kept closed between the hours of 22.00 and 07.00. No vehicles may access the area behind the gates within these hours.

Condition : 5 - The lighting scheme shall be operated in accordance with the approved scheme for 00505/BN/P17, as amended by the Lighting Statement submitted for the application hereby approved and numbered 2330 (2 June 2010) by Atelier Ten. The evening event phase shall be switched off after 1am, following an event. For the rest of the year the evening lighting phase as originally approved shall be implemented.

Condition : 6 - No deliveries by, car transporters, oil tankers, or other large vehicles shall be taken to, or dispatched from, the site within the peak hours during the morning (08.00-09.00) and evening (17.00-18.00) on weekdays and Saturday's, or as otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The consent hereby approves up to 36 events per annum with no more than four events in any one month, held in the Audi Quattro rooms between the hours of 6pm and 11.30pm, including between 60 and 340 people (including guests and staff) and involving hospitality and/or dining and where the client (the user of the premises) is not an Audi UK, or an associated company or a member of the Volkswagen Group, unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority. An annum shall start on the 1 January and end on the 31 December.
Condition : 8 - All guests shall have exited the premises by 11.30pm. All staff shall have left the premises by 1am to allow for clean up. There shall be no people left in the building by 1am.

Condition : 9 - The use hereby approved shall be operated at all times in accordance with the Car Park Management Plan for Events (Report Number 2416/03), Travel Plan (Report Number 2416/02) and Transport Statement (Report Number 2416/01) and the attached plans referenced 1.1 and 1.2.

Condition : 10 - The use hereby approved shall be overseen and managed by a manager from Audi Quattro Management Team, as outlined within the Car Park Management Plan for Events (Report Number 2416/03), Travel Plan (Report Number 2416/02) and Transport Statement (Report Number 2416/01), or unless otherwise agreed with the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 11 - The activity hereby granted shall have no external music, outdoor events or amplified sounds within the grounds of the building.
description: Proposed dual use of second and third floors as offices with ancillary Exhibition & Conferencing facilities.
